<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Demands for electoral reform:</strong> Opposition leaders, including Mamata Banerjee, are demanding that elections be conducted using previous voter lists, citing concerns over the integrity of the current SIR process.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
